{{Short description|American environmental chemist}}
{{Orphan|date=May 2017}}

'''Samuel Traina''' is an American environmental [[chemist]] and a founder of [[The Sierra Nevada Research Institute]] whose work used to be funded by the [[National Science Foundation]], the [[United States Department of Energy]] and the [[United States Environmental Protection Agency]]. He also a member of various committees such as the [[Earth Resources Committee]] and [[United States National Research Council|National Research Council]]. From 1985 to 2002 he was faculty member of the [[Ohio State University]] and was a co-director of the [[Environmental Molecular Science Institute]].<ref>{{cite web|url=http://www.ccst.us/ccstinfo/board/bios/traina.php|title=Samuel Traina|date= November 10, 2010|accessdate=October 8, 2013}}</ref>
